Apple Health Longevity Intro Animation

On the Longevity tab intro screen, a central vector illustration plays an automatic onboarding sequence. Various colored pillar shapes (representing nutrition, cardio, sleep, mind, and mobility) take turns expanding to center stage, revealing category icons with soft pulse-scaling motions while smaller nodes orbit around them. After each pillar is introduced, the elements smoothly fly, scale, and snap together into a complete circular pinwheel chart accompanied by an outer white bounding frame.
